method: Original fresh audit contributes only pinned point coordinates and candidate angle intervals. Independent local checker recomputes strict ownership bounds, full-angle core and wall inequalities, all rational charge regions, and an exact vertical sweep at every polygon-edge intersection and between events. It binds the previously accepted local D4 cover result and compares recomputed whole-half-turn case transfers against the pinned A1 list. No fetched source checker is executed.
scope: One of 59 field certificates, mask 0. All 55 conditioned owner points and 136 positive-cell rows were checked; 459 transferred canonical cases follow. Other field/generic/returned certificates and global optimality remain unchecked.
shared_premises: The accepted D4 cover geometry, the packet’s fixed field sites/owner point proposals, U and L, and the elementary strict-core collision and odd-majority capacity-one arguments are explicit premises. This one-packet check does not validate the other 58 field certificates, 34 generic certificates, 76 prior extensions, 173 returned cases, or case 438 capture.
